verdict.rationale: Omnara documents a REST API with bearer-token authentication, a TypeScript SDK, and a CLI, and agents can be launched and operated programmatically. A probe confirms a live OpenAPI spec at docs.omnara.com/openapi.json and an llms.txt describing it as 'The API for Production-Grade Agents', and API keys can be assigned scoped roles. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.
